description_zh: 将网盘中的文件或文件夹移动至新的位置
kebab_example: aliyun ecd move-cds-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3460630000 --file-id 63f3257b68b018170b194d87b875512d108f0000 --end-user-id user01 --parent-folder-id 6409848a6da91d6240604e7ba7337d85ba8a10000 --conflict-policy ignore --group-id cg-hvyou5jbob3b00000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveCdsFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud disk
parameters.name: cds_id

parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID that you want to use to access the cloud disk
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder that you want to move. If you want to remove the root folder, set the value to root
parameters.help_zh: 复制目的地位置的父文件夹ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID。当移动至根目录时，填`root`
parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.help_en:
The processing mode of files that have the same name.

Valid values:

*   <!-- -->

    refuse

    <!-- -->

    : If you want to create a file that uses the same name as an existing file in the cloud, the system denies your request and returns the details of the existing file.

    <!-- -->

*   <!-- -->

    auto_rename

    <!-- -->

    : If you want to create a file that uses the same name as an existing file in the cloud, the system renames the file that you want to create by appending the current time point.

    <!-- -->

*   <!-- -->

    ignore

    <!-- -->

    : The system allows you to create a file that uses the same name as an existing file in the cloud.

    <!-- -->

*   <!-- -->

    over_write

    <!-- -->

    : After you create a file that uses the same name as an existing file in the cloud, the new file overwrites the existing file.

    <!-- -->
parameters.name: conflict_policy
